176  /** Transforms the value to the SQL statement lower(val). */
177  protected String toSQLLower(String val) {
178    return "lower(" + val + ")";
179  }
180
181  /**
182   * Escapes a value for use inside a single-quoted Hive/Spark SQL string literal. Backslashes are
183   * escaped first, so a user-supplied backslash can't be used to escape the closing quote.
184   */
185  public static String escapeSQLString(String value) {
186    if (value == null) {
187      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null values cannot be used in a SQL string literal");
188    }
189    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(value.length() + 8);
190    for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
191      char c = value.charAt(i);
192      switch (c) {
193        case '\\':
194          sb.append("\\\\");
195          break;
196        case '\'':
197          sb.append("\\'");
198          break;
199        default:
200          sb.append(c);
201      }
202    }
203    return sb.toString();
204  }
205
206  /** Escapes and single-quotes a value as a Hive/Spark SQL string literal. */
207  public static String quote(String value) {
208    return '\'' + escapeSQLString(value) + '\'';
209  }
210
211  /**
212   * Converts a user wildcard pattern (* and ?) to the body of a quoted SQL LIKE pattern. SQL LIKE
213   * wildcards (% and _) and backslashes in the user's value are matched literally.
214   *
215   * <p>The returned value is already escaped for use inside a single-quoted literal.
216   */
217  protected static String toSQLLikePatternBody(String value) {
218    if (value == null) {
219      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null values cannot be used in a LIKE pattern");
220    }
221    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(value.length() + 8);
222    for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
223      char c = value.charAt(i);
224      switch (c) {
225        case '%':
226          // Hive and Spark keep the backslash in '\%' and '\_', so LIKE sees an escaped wildcard.
227          sb.append("\\%");
228          break;
229        case '_':
230          sb.append("\\_");
231          break;
232        case '*':
233          sb.append('%');
234          break;
235        case '?':
236          sb.append('_');
237          break;
238        case '\\':
239          // Escaped once for LIKE and once for the string literal.
240          sb.append("\\\\\\\\");
241          break;
242        default:
243          sb.append(escapeSQLString(String.valueOf(c)));
244      }
245    }
246    return sb.toString();
247  }
248
249  /** Checks that a value is a plain decimal number, so it can be written unquoted. */
250  protected static String requireNumeric(String value) {
251    if (value == null) {
252      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Null is not a valid number");
253    }
254    String trimmed = value.trim();
255    try {
256      new java.math.BigDecimal(trimmed);
257    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
258      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid number: " + value, e);
259    }
260    return trimmed;
261  }
262
263  /** Checks that a value is a boolean, so it can be written unquoted. */
264  protected static String requireBoolean(String value) {
265    if (value != null) {
266      String trimmed = value.trim();
267      if ("true".equalsIgnoreCase(trimmed) || "false".equalsIgnoreCase(trimmed)) {
268        return trimmed;
269      }
270    }
271    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid boolean: " + value);
272  }
273
274  protected String toSQLField(S param, boolean matchCase) {
275    return Optional.ofNullable(term(param))
276        .map(
277            term -> {
278              String sqlCol = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term);
279              if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
280                  && (param != OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOMETRY)
281                  && (param != OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME)
282                  && !matchCase) {
283                return toSQLLower(sqlCol);
284              }
285              return sqlCol;
286            })
287        .orElseThrow(
288            () ->
289                // QueryBuildingException requires an underlying exception
290                new IllegalArgumentException(
291                    "Search parameter " + param.type().getName() + "." + param + " is not mapped"));
292  }
293
294  /**
295   * Allow support for querying the denormalized extension.
296   *
297   * @param param
298   * @param matchCase
299   * @return
300   */
301  protected String toSQLDenormField(S param, boolean matchCase) {
302    return Optional.ofNullable(term(param))
303        .map(
304            term -> {
305              if (term instanceof DwcTerm) {
306                DwcTerm dwcTerm = (DwcTerm) term;
307                String field = "Denorm.parents." + dwcTerm.simpleName();
308                if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
309                    && !"GEOMETRY".equals(param.name())
310                    && !matchCase) {
311                  return toSQLLower(field);
312                }
313                return field;
314              }
315              return null;
316            })
317        .orElseThrow(
318            () ->
319                // QueryBuildingException requires an underlying exception
320                new IllegalArgumentException(
321                    "Search parameter " + param + " is not mapped to Hive"));
322  }
323
324  /**
325   * Converts a value to the form expected by Hive based on the SearchParameter. Most values pass by
326   * unaltered. Quotes are added for values that need to be quoted, escaping any existing quotes.
327   *
328   * @param param the type of parameter defining the expected type
329   * @param value the original query value
330   * @return the converted value expected by Hive
331   */
332  protected String toSQLValue(S param, String value, boolean matchCase) {
333    if (OccurrenceStatus.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
334      return quote(
335          VocabularyUtils.lookup(value, OccurrenceStatus.class)
336              .map(OccurrenceStatus::normalize)
337              .map(Enum::name)
338              .orElse(value.toUpperCase()));
339    }
340    if (Enum.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
341      // all enum parameters are uppercase
342      return quote(value.toUpperCase());
343    }
344
345    if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
346      // use longs for timestamps expressed as ISO dates
347      LocalDate ld = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDate(value);
348      Instant i = ld.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant();
349      if (isInterpretedUtcDateMilliseconds(term(param))) {
350        return String.valueOf(i.toEpochMilli());
351      } else {
352        return String.valueOf(i.getEpochSecond());
353      }
354
355    } else if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
356      // do not quote numbers, but make sure they really are numbers
357      return requireNumeric(value);
358
359    } else if (Boolean.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
360      return requireBoolean(value);
361
362    } else {
363      // quote and escape the value
364      String strVal = quote(value);
365      if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
366          && !"GEOMETRY".equals(param.name())
367          && OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME != param
368          && !matchCase) {
369        return toSQLLower(strVal);
370      }
371      return strVal;
372    }
373  }
374
375  /**
376   * Translates a valid {@link org.gbif.api.model.occurrence.Download} object and translates it into
377   * a strings that can be used as the <em>WHERE</em> clause for a SQL (hive or spark) download.
378   *
379   * @param predicate to translate
380   * @return WHERE clause
381   */
382  public String buildQuery(Predicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
383    String query = ALL_QUERY;
384    if (predicate != null) { // null predicate means a SELECT ALL
385      builder = new StringBuilder();
386      visit(predicate);
387      query = builder.toString();
388    }
389
390    // Set to null to prevent old StringBuilders hanging around in case this class is reused
391    // somewhere else
392    builder = null;
393    return query;
394  }

396  public void visit(ConjunctionPredicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
397    visitCompoundPredicate(predicate, CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
398  }
399
400  public void visit(DisjunctionPredicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
401    // See if this disjunction can be simplified into an IN predicate, which is much faster.
402    // We could overcomplicate this:
403    //   A=1 OR A=2 OR B=3 OR B=4 OR C>5 → A IN(1,2) OR B IN (3,4) OR C>5
404    // but that's a very unusual query for us, so we just check for
405    // - EqualsPredicates everywhere
406    // - on the same search parameter.
407
408    boolean useIn = true;
409    Boolean matchCase = null;
410    List<String> values = new ArrayList<>();
411    S parameter = null;
412    UUID checklistsKey = null;
413    UUID suppliedChecklistKey = null;
414
415    for (Predicate subPredicate : predicate.getPredicates()) {
416      if (subPredicate instanceof EqualsPredicate) {
417        EqualsPredicate<S> equalsSubPredicate = (EqualsPredicate<S>) subPredicate;
418        if (parameter == null) {
419          parameter = equalsSubPredicate.getKey();
420          matchCase = equalsSubPredicate.isMatchCase();
421          suppliedChecklistKey = equalsSubPredicate.getChecklistKey();
422          checklistsKey = getChecklistKey(suppliedChecklistKey);
423        } else if (parameter != equalsSubPredicate.getKey()
424            || matchCase != equalsSubPredicate.isMatchCase()
425            || !Objects.equals(
426                checklistsKey, getChecklistKey(equalsSubPredicate.getChecklistKey()))) {
427          useIn = false;
428          break;
429        }
430        values.add(equalsSubPredicate.getValue());
431      } else {
432        useIn = false;
433        break;
434      }
435    }
436
437    if (useIn && OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME != parameter) {
438      visit(new InPredicate<>(parameter, values, matchCase, suppliedChecklistKey));
439    } else {
440      visitCompoundPredicate(predicate, DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
441    }
442  }

444  private String arrayContains(Term term, String value, boolean matchCase) {
445    return String.format(
446        "stringArrayContains(%s,'%s',%b)",
447        sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term), escapeSQLString(value), matchCase);
448  }

450  private String arrayLike(Term term, String value, boolean matchCase) {
451    return String.format(
452        "stringArrayLike(%s,'%s',%b)",
453        sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term), escapeSQLString(value), matchCase);
454  }

456  /** Supports all parameters incl taxonKey expansion for higher taxa. */
457  public void visit(EqualsPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
458    if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getKey())) {
459      appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(predicate);
460    } else if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getKey())) {
461      appendTaxonomicFilter(predicate);
462    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
463      appendGadmFilterList(GADM_GIDS, predicate.getValue());
464    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.MEDIA_TYPE) {
465      Optional.ofNullable(VocabularyUtils.lookupEnum(predicate.getValue(), MediaType.class))
466          .ifPresent(
467              mediaType ->
468                  builder.append(arrayContains(GbifTerm.mediaType, mediaType.name(), true)));
469    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.ISSUE) {
470      builder.append(arrayContains(GbifTerm.issue, predicate.getValue().toUpperCase(), true));
471    } else if (isSQLArray(predicate.getKey())) {
472      builder.append(
473          arrayContains(
474              sqlTermsMapper.getTermArray(predicate.getKey()),
475              predicate.getValue(),
476              predicate.isMatchCase()));
477    } else if (sqlTermsMapper.isDenormedTerm(predicate.getKey())) {
478      builder
479          .append("(")
480          .append("(")
481          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
482          .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
483          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
484          .append(") OR (")
485          .append("stringArrayContains(")
486          .append(toSQLDenormField(predicate.getKey(), true))
487          .append(",")
488          .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), true))
489          .append("))")
490          .append(")");
491    } else if (SQLColumnsUtils.isVocabulary(term(predicate.getKey()))) {
492      builder.append(arrayContains(term(predicate.getKey()), predicate.getValue(), false));
493    } else if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
494      // Dates may contain a range even for an EqualsPredicate (e.g. "2000" or "2000-02")
495      // The user's query value is inclusive, but the parsed dateRange is exclusive of the
496      // upperBound to allow including the day itself.
497      //
498      // I.e. a predicate value 2000/2005-03 gives a dateRange [2000-01-01,2005-04-01)
499      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
500
501      if (dateRange.hasLowerBound() || dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
502        builder.append('(');
503        if (dateRange.hasLowerBound()) {
504          visitSimplePredicate(
505              predicate,
506              GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
507              ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
508          if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
509            builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
510          }
511        }
512        if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
513          visitSimplePredicate(
514              predicate, LESS_THAN_OPERATOR, ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.upperEndpoint()));
515        }
516        builder.append(')');
517      }
518    } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
519      // Dates may contain a range even for an EqualsPredicate (e.g. "2000" or "2000-02")
520      // The user's query value is inclusive, but the parsed dateRange is exclusive of the
521      // upperBound to allow including the day itself.
522      //
523      // I.e. a predicate value 2000/2005-03 gives a dateRange [2000-01-01,2005-04-01)
524      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
525
526      if (dateRange.hasLowerBound() || dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
527        // all the stuff here
528        builder.append('(');
529        if (dateRange.hasLowerBound()) {
530          SimplePredicate predicateGte =
531              new EqualsPredicate<>(
532                  InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_GTE,
533                  predicate.getValue(),
534                  predicate.isMatchCase());
535          visitSimplePredicate(
536              predicateGte,
537              GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
538              ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
539          if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
540            builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
541          }
542        }
543        if (dateRange.hasUpperBound()) {
544          SimplePredicate predicateLte =
545              new EqualsPredicate<>(
546                  InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_LTE,
547                  predicate.getValue(),
548                  predicate.isMatchCase());
549          visitSimplePredicate(
550              predicateLte,
551              LESS_THAN_OPERATOR,
552              ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.upperEndpoint()));
553        }
554        builder.append(')');
555      }
556    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME) {
557      if (SearchTypeValidator.isNumericRange(predicate.getValue())) {
558        Range<Double> range = SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(predicate.getValue());
559        if (range.hasLowerBound()) {
560          builder
561              .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_GT_COLUMN)
562              .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
563              .append(range.lowerEndpoint());
564        }
565        if (range.hasUpperBound()) {
566          if (range.hasLowerBound()) {
567            builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
568          }
569          builder
570              .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_LTE_COLUMN)
571              .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
572              .append(range.upperEndpoint());
573        }
574      } else {
575        String value = requireNumeric(predicate.getValue());
576        builder
577            .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_GT_COLUMN)
578            .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
579            .append(value)
580            .append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
581            .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_LTE_COLUMN)
582            .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
583            .append(value);
584      }
585    } else {
586      visitSimplePredicate(predicate, EQUALS_OPERATOR);
587    }
588  }

590  private void appendTaxonomicFilter(EqualsPredicate<S> predicate) {
591
592    // For TAXON_KEY use the taxonKeys column - this will support taxon keys at any rank
593    if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXON_KEY) {
594      builder
595          .append('(')
596          .append(
597              String.format(
598                  "stringArrayContains(%s, '%s', true)",
599                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonkeys", predicate.getChecklistKey()),
600                  escapeSQLString(predicate.getValue())))
601          .append(')');
602    } else if (isTaxonomicArrayParameter(predicate.getKey())) {
603      // special case for taxonomic issues and environments, which are stored in an ARRAY, the
604      // other taxon fields are STRING
605      builder
606          .append('(')
607          .append(
608              String.format(
609                  "stringArrayContains(%s, '%s', true)",
610                  resolveTaxonColumnName(
611                      taxonomicArrayColumn(predicate.getKey()), predicate.getChecklistKey()),
612                  escapeSQLString(predicate.getValue())))
613          .append(')');
614    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.IUCN_RED_LIST_CATEGORY) {
615      // special case for IUCN to make case-insensitive for backwards compatibility
616      String columnName = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
617      builder
618          .append("lower(" + resolveTaxonColumnName(columnName, predicate.getChecklistKey()) + ")")
619          .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
620          .append(toSQLLower(quote(predicate.getValue())));
621    } else {
622      String columnName = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
623      String resolvedColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(columnName, predicate.getChecklistKey());
624      String quotedValue = quote(predicate.getValue());
625      if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME
626          && !predicate.isMatchCase()) {
627        builder
628            .append(toSQLLower(resolvedColumn))
629            .append(EQUALS_OPERATOR)
630            .append(toSQLLower(quotedValue));
631      } else {
632        builder.append(resolvedColumn).append(EQUALS_OPERATOR).append(quotedValue);
633      }
634    }
635  }

637  /**
638   * Resolves the column name for a taxon field based on the checklist key. If the checklist key is
639   * not the denormalised taxonomy, it will prepend the appropriate nested struct prefix to the
640   * column name.
641   *
642   * @param sqlField the SQL field name to resolve
643   * @param suppliedChecklistKey the checklist key provided in the predicate, may be null
644   * @return the resolved column name with the appropriate prefix if necessary
645   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the checklist key is not mapped to a nested struct in the
646   *     table
647   */
648  public String resolveTaxonColumnName(String sqlField, UUID suppliedChecklistKey) {
649    String queryFieldPrefix = "";
650    UUID checklistKey = getChecklistKey(suppliedChecklistKey);
651    if (!denormalizedTaxonomy.equals(checklistKey)) {
652      if (checklistNestedStructMap.containsKey(checklistKey)) {
653        queryFieldPrefix =
654            disambiguationTable + "." + checklistNestedStructMap.get(checklistKey) + ".";
655      } else {
656        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
657            "Checklist key "
658                + checklistKey
659                + " is not mapped to a nested struct in the table. Please add it to the checklistNestedStructMap.");
660      }
661    }
662    return queryFieldPrefix + sqlField;
663  }

665  public void visit(GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
666    if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
667      // Where the date is a range, consider the "OrEquals" to mean including the whole range.
668      // "2000" includes all of 2000.
669      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
670      visitSimplePredicate(
671          predicate,
672          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
673          ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
674    } else if (IsoDateInterval.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
675      // Where the date is a range, consider the "OrEquals" to mean including the whole range.
676      // "2000" includes all of 2000.
677      Range<LocalDate> dateRange = IsoDateParsingUtils.parseDateRange(predicate.getValue());
678      SimplePredicate predicateLte =
679          new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(
680              InternalOccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE_LTE, predicate.getValue());
681      visitSimplePredicate(
682          predicateLte,
683          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR,
684          ISO_DATE_FORMATTER.format(dateRange.lowerEndpoint()));
685    } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME == predicate.getKey()) {
686      builder
687          .append(GEOLOGICAL_TIME_GT_COLUMN)
688          .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
689          .append(requireNumeric(predicate.getValue()));
690    } else {
691      visitSimplePredicate(predicate, GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR);
692    }
693  }

782  public void visit(RangePredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
783    builder.append("((");
784
785    if (!Objects.isNull(predicate.getValue().getGte())) {
786      visitSimplePredicate(
787          new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getGte()),
788          GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR);
789    } else {
790      visitSimplePredicate(
791          new LessThanPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getGt()),
792          GREATER_THAN_OPERATOR);
793    }
794
795    builder.append(")");
796    builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
797    builder.append("(");
798
799    if (!Objects.isNull(predicate.getValue().getLte())) {
800      visitSimplePredicate(
801          new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getLte()),
802          LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR);
803    } else {
804      visitSimplePredicate(
805          new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue().getLt()),
806          LESS_THAN_OPERATOR);
807    }
808    builder.append("))");
809  }

811  /*
812   * For large disjunctions, IN predicates are around 3× faster than a perfectly balanced tree of
813   * OR predicates, and around 2× faster than a fairly flat OR query.
814   *
815   * With Hive 1.3.0, balancing OR queries should be internal to Hive:
816   *   https://jira.apache.org/jira/browse/HIVE-11398
817   * but it is probably still better to use an IN, which uses a hash table lookup internally:
818   *   https://jira.apache.org/jira/browse/HIVE-11415#comment-14651085
819   */
820  public void visit(InPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
821    log.info("InPredicate " + predicate);
822
823    boolean isMatchCase = Optional.ofNullable(predicate.isMatchCase()).orElse(Boolean.FALSE);
824
825    if (isSQLArray(predicate.getKey()) || SQLColumnsUtils.isVocabulary(term(predicate.getKey()))) {
826      // Array values must be converted to ORs.
827      builder.append('(');
828      Iterator<String> iterator = predicate.getValues().iterator();
829      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
830        // Use the equals predicate to get the behaviour for array.
831        visit(new EqualsPredicate<S>(predicate.getKey(), iterator.next(), isMatchCase));
832        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
833          builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
834        }
835      }
836      builder.append(')');
837    } else if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getKey())) {
838      appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(predicate);
839    } else if (TAXON_KEY_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getKey())) {
840      appendTaxonKeyArrayFilter(predicate);
841    } else if (isTaxonomicArrayParameter(predicate.getKey())) {
842      appendTaxonomicArrayFilter(predicate, taxonomicArrayColumn(predicate.getKey()));
843    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.TAXONOMIC_STATUS) {
844      appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilter(predicate, "taxonomicstatus");
845    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.IUCN_RED_LIST_CATEGORY) {
846      appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilterCaseInsensitive(predicate, "iucnredlistcategory");
847    } else if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
848      // GADM GIDs must be expanded into a disjunction of in predicates
849      appendGadmGidFilter(predicate.getValues());
850    } else if ("EVENT_DATE".equals(predicate.getKey().name())) {
851      // Event dates must be expanded into a disjunction of conjunction predicates (of comparisons)
852      builder.append('(');
853      Iterator<String> iterator = predicate.getValues().iterator();
854      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
855        // Use the equals predicate to get the behaviour for event dates.
856        visit(new EqualsPredicate<S>(predicate.getKey(), iterator.next(), isMatchCase));
857        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
858          builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
859        }
860      }
861      builder.append(')');
862
863    } else if (OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME == predicate.getKey()) {
864      List<Predicate> allPredicates =
865          predicate.getValues().stream()
866              .map(v -> new EqualsPredicate<>(predicate.getKey(), v, false))
867              .collect(Collectors.toList());
868      visit(new DisjunctionPredicate(allPredicates));
869    } else {
870      builder
871          .append('(')
872          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), isMatchCase))
873          .append(IN_OPERATOR)
874          .append('(');
875      Iterator<String> iterator = predicate.getValues().iterator();
876      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
877        builder.append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), iterator.next(), isMatchCase));
878        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
879          builder.append(", ");
880        }
881      }
882      builder.append(")");
883
884      // this block can be removed in future if we don't need a denormalized
885      // AVRO extension
886      if (sqlTermsMapper.isDenormedTerm(predicate.getKey())) {
887        builder.append(" OR ").append('(');
888
889        Iterator<String> iterator2 = predicate.getValues().iterator();
890        while (iterator2.hasNext()) {
891          builder
892              .append('(')
893              .append("array_contains(")
894              .append(toSQLDenormField(predicate.getKey(), true))
895              .append(',')
896              .append(toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), iterator2.next(), true))
897              .append(')')
898              .append(')');
899          if (iterator2.hasNext()) {
900            builder.append(" OR ");
901          }
902        }
903        builder.append(")");
904      }
905      builder.append(")");
906    }
907  }

909  public void visit(LikePredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
910    if (sqlTermsMapper.isArray(predicate.getKey())) {
911      builder.append(
912          arrayLike(
913              sqlTermsMapper.getTermArray(predicate.getKey()),
914              predicate.getValue(),
915              predicate.isMatchCase()));
916    } else {
917      // % → \%, _ → \_, \ → \\, then * → % and ? → _, escaped for the string literal.
918      String likeValue =
919          toSQLLikeValue(predicate.getKey(), predicate.getValue(), predicate.isMatchCase());
920
921      if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getKey())) {
922
923        String columnName = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
924        String resolvedColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(columnName, predicate.getChecklistKey());
925        if (predicate.getKey() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.SCIENTIFIC_NAME
926            && !predicate.isMatchCase()) {
927          builder.append(toSQLLower(resolvedColumn)).append(LIKE_OPERATOR).append(likeValue);
928        } else {
929          builder.append(resolvedColumn).append(LIKE_OPERATOR).append(likeValue);
930        }
931      } else {
932        appendSimplePredicate(predicate, LIKE_OPERATOR, likeValue);
933      }
934    }
935  }
936
937  /**
938   * Converts a user wildcard value into a quoted SQL LIKE pattern, lowercased in the same cases as
939   * {@link #toSQLValue(SearchParameter, String, boolean)}.
940   */
941  protected String toSQLLikeValue(S param, String value, boolean matchCase) {
942    if (Enum.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())) {
943      return '\'' + toSQLLikePatternBody(value.toUpperCase()) + '\'';
944    }
945    String strVal = '\'' + toSQLLikePatternBody(value) + '\'';
946    if (String.class.isAssignableFrom(param.type())
947        && !"GEOMETRY".equals(param.name())
948        && OccurrenceSearchParameter.GEOLOGICAL_TIME != param
949        && !matchCase) {
950      return toSQLLower(strVal);
951    }
952    return strVal;
953  }

955  public void visit(NotPredicate predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
956    builder.append(NOT_OPERATOR);
957    visit(predicate.getPredicate());
958  }

960  public void visit(IsNotNullPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
961    if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getParameter())) {
962      appendHumboldtTaxonUnary(
963          getChecklistKey(predicate.getChecklistKey()), IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR);
964    } else if (isSQLArray(predicate.getParameter())
965        || SQLColumnsUtils.isVocabulary(term(predicate.getParameter()))) {
966      builder.append(
967          String.format(IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true)));
968    } else if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getParameter())) {
969      appendTaxonKeyIsNotNull(predicate);
970    } else if (predicate.getParameter() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
971      appendUnaryList(GADM_GIDS, IS_NOT_NULL_OPERATOR);
972    } else {
973      // matchCase: Avoid adding an unnecessary "lower()" when just testing for null.
974      builder.append(toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true));
975      builder.append(IS_NOT_NULL_OPERATOR);
976    }
977  }

979  public void visit(IsNullPredicate<S> predicate) throws QueryBuildingException {
980    if (TAXON_SEARCH_PARAMETERS.contains(predicate.getParameter())) {
981      appendTaxonKeyNull(predicate);
982    } else if (isHumboldtTaxonParameter(predicate.getParameter())) {
983      appendHumboldtTaxonUnary(
984          getChecklistKey(predicate.getChecklistKey()), IS_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR);
985    } else if (predicate.getParameter() == OccurrenceSearchParameter.GADM_GID) {
986      appendUnaryList(GADM_GIDS, IS_NULL_OPERATOR);
987    } else {
988      // matchCase: Avoid adding an unnecessary "lower()" when just testing for null.
989      if (isSQLArray(predicate.getParameter())) {
990        builder.append(
991            String.format(IS_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true)));
992      } else {
993        builder.append(toSQLField(predicate.getParameter(), true));
994        builder.append(IS_NULL_OPERATOR);
995      }
996    }
997  }

999  /** Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank. */
1000  private void appendTaxonKeyIsNotNull(IsNotNullPredicate<S> predicate) {
1001    String sqlField = predicate.getParameter().name().replace("_", "").toLowerCase();
1002    if (isTaxonomicArrayParameter(predicate.getParameter())) {
1003      String taxonomicIssueColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, predicate.getChecklistKey());
1004      builder.append(
1005          String.format(
1006              "%s IS NOT NULL OR size(%s) > 0", taxonomicIssueColumn, taxonomicIssueColumn));
1007    } else {
1008      builder.append(
1009          String.format(
1010              "%s IS NOT NULL", resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, predicate.getChecklistKey())));
1011    }
1012  }
1013
1014  /** Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank. */
1015  private void appendTaxonKeyNull(IsNullPredicate<S> predicate) {
1016    String sqlField = predicate.getParameter().name().replace("_", "").toLowerCase();
1017    if (isTaxonomicArrayParameter(predicate.getParameter())) {
1018      String taxonomicIssueColumn = resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, predicate.getChecklistKey());
1019      builder.append(
1020          String.format(
1021              "%s IS NOT NULL OR size(%s) = 0", taxonomicIssueColumn, taxonomicIssueColumn));
1022    } else {
1023      builder.append(
1024          String.format(
1025              "%s IS NULL", resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, predicate.getChecklistKey())));
1026    }
1027  }

1029  public void visit(WithinPredicate within) throws QueryBuildingException {
1030    JtsSpatialContextFactory spatialContextFactory = new JtsSpatialContextFactory();
1031    spatialContextFactory.normWrapLongitude = true;
1032    spatialContextFactory.srid = 4326;
1033    spatialContextFactory.datelineRule = DatelineRule.ccwRect;
1034
1035    WKTReader reader =
1036        new WKTReader(spatialContextFactory.newSpatialContext(), spatialContextFactory);
1037
1038    try {
1039      // the geometry must be valid - it was validated in the predicates constructor
1040      Shape geometry = reader.parse(within.getGeometry());
1041
1042      builder.append('(');
1043      String withinGeometry;
1044
1045      // Add an additional filter to a bounding box around any shapes that aren't quadrilaterals, to
1046      // speed up the query.
1047      if (geometry instanceof JtsGeometry
1048          && ((JtsGeometry) geometry).getGeom().getNumPoints() != 5) {
1049        Geometry g = ((JtsGeometry) geometry).getGeom();
1050        // Use the Spatial4J-fixed geometry; this is split into a multipolygon if it crosses the
1051        // antimeridian.
1052        withinGeometry = g.toText();
1053
1054        Rectangle bounds = geometry.getBoundingBox();
1055        boundingBox(bounds);
1056        builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1057
1058        // A tool (R?) can generate hundreds of tiny areas spread across the globe, all in a single
1059        // multipolygon.
1060        // Add bounding boxes for these too.
1061        // Example: https://www.gbif.org/occurrence/download/0187894-210914110416597
1062        if (g instanceof MultiPolygon && g.getNumGeometries() > 2) {
1063          builder.append("((");
1064          for (int i = 0; i < g.getNumGeometries(); i++) {
1065            if (i > 0) {
1066              // Too many clauses exceeds Hive's query parsing stack.
1067              if (i % 500 == 0) {
1068                builder.append(')');
1069                builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1070                builder.append('(');
1071              } else {
1072                builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1073              }
1074            }
1075            Geometry gi = g.getGeometryN(i);
1076            Envelope env = gi.getEnvelopeInternal();
1077            boundingBox(
1078                new RectangleImpl(
1079                    env.getMinX(),
1080                    env.getMaxX(),
1081                    env.getMinY(),
1082                    env.getMaxY(),
1083                    geometry.getContext()));
1084          }
1085          builder.append("))");
1086          builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1087        }
1088      } else {
1089        withinGeometry = within.getGeometry();
1090      }
1091      builder
1092          .append("contains(")
1093          .append(quote(withinGeometry))
1094          .append(", ")
1095          .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1096          .append(", ")
1097          .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude));
1098      // Without the "= TRUE", the expression may evaluate to TRUE or FALSE for all records,
1099      // depending
1100      // on the data format (ORC, Avro, Parquet, text) of the table (!).
1101      // We could not reproduce the issue on our test cluster, so it seems safest to include this.
1102      builder.append(") = TRUE").append(')');
1103    } catch (Exception e) {
1104      throw new QueryBuildingException(e);
1105    }
1106  }
1107
1108  public void visit(GeoDistancePredicate geoDistance) throws QueryBuildingException {
1109    builder
1110        .append("(geoDistance(")
1111        .append(geoDistance.getGeoDistance().getLatitude())
1112        .append(", ")
1113        .append(geoDistance.getGeoDistance().getLongitude())
1114        .append(", ")
1115        .append(quote(geoDistance.getGeoDistance().getDistance().toString()))
1116        .append(", ")
1117        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1118        .append(", ")
1119        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude))
1120        .append(") = TRUE)");
1121  }
1122
1123  /**
1124   * Given a bounding box, generates greater than / lesser than queries using decimalLatitude and
1125   * decimalLongitude to form a bounding box.
1126   */
1127  private void boundingBox(Rectangle bounds) {
1128    builder
1129        .append('(')
1130        // Latitude is easy:
1131        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1132        .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1133        .append(bounds.getMinY())
1134        .append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1135        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLatitude))
1136        .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1137        .append(bounds.getMaxY())
1138        .append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1139
1140        // Longitude must take account of crossing the antimeridian:
1141        .append('(')
1142        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude))
1143        .append(GREATER_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1144        .append(bounds.getMinX());
1145    if (bounds.getMinX() < bounds.getMaxX()) {
1146      builder.append(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1147    } else {
1148      builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1149    }
1150    builder
1151        .append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(DwcTerm.decimalLongitude))
1152        .append(LESS_THAN_EQUALS_OPERATOR)
1153        .append(bounds.getMaxX())
1154        .append(')')
1155        .append(')');
1156  }
1157
1158  /**
1159   * Builds a list of predicates joined by 'op' statements. The final statement will look like this:
1160   *
1161   * <p>
1162   *
1163   * <pre>
1164   * ((predicate) op (predicate) ... op (predicate))
1165   * </pre>
1166   */
1167  public void visitCompoundPredicate(CompoundPredicate predicate, String op)
1168      throws QueryBuildingException {
1169    builder.append('(');
1170    Iterator<Predicate> iterator = predicate.getPredicates().iterator();
1171    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1172      Predicate subPredicate = iterator.next();
1173      builder.append('(');
1174      visit(subPredicate);
1175      builder.append(')');
1176      if (iterator.hasNext()) {
1177        builder.append(op);
1178      }
1179    }
1180    builder.append(')');
1181  }
1182
1183  public void visitSimplePredicate(SimplePredicate<S> predicate, String op)
1184      throws QueryBuildingException {
1185    if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(predicate.getKey().type())) {
1186      if (SearchTypeValidator.isNumericRange(predicate.getValue())) {
1187        if (Integer.class.equals(predicate.getKey().type())) {
1188          visit(
1189              toIntegerRangePredicate(
1190                  SearchTypeValidator.parseIntegerRange(predicate.getValue()), predicate.getKey()));
1191        } else {
1192          visit(
1193              toNumberRangePredicate(
1194                  SearchTypeValidator.parseDecimalRange(predicate.getValue()), predicate.getKey()));
1195        }
1196        return;
1197      }
1198    }
1199
1200    visitSimplePredicate(predicate, op, predicate.getValue());
1201  }
1202
1203  public void visitSimplePredicate(SimplePredicate<S> predicate, String op, String value)
1204      throws QueryBuildingException {
1205    appendSimplePredicate(
1206        predicate, op, toSQLValue(predicate.getKey(), value, predicate.isMatchCase()));
1207  }
1208
1209  /**
1210   * Appends "field op value", where sqlValue has already been converted to a safe SQL expression.
1211   */
1212  private void appendSimplePredicate(SimplePredicate<S> predicate, String op, String sqlValue) {
1213    if (sqlTermsMapper.includeNullInPredicate(predicate)) {
1214      String column = sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLColumn(term(predicate.getKey()));
1215      builder
1216          .append('(')
1217          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1218          .append(op)
1219          .append(sqlValue)
1220          .append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR)
1221          .append(
1222              isSQLArray(predicate.getKey())
1223                  ? String.format(IS_NOT_NULL_ARRAY_OPERATOR, column)
1224                  : column + IS_NULL_OPERATOR)
1225          .append(')');
1226    } else {
1227      builder
1228          .append(toSQLField(predicate.getKey(), predicate.isMatchCase()))
1229          .append(op)
1230          .append(sqlValue);
1231    }
1232  }

1234  /** Determines if the parameter type is a Hive array. */
1235  protected boolean isSQLArray(S parameter) {
1236    return sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLType(term(parameter)).startsWith(SQL_ARRAY_PRE);

1244  private void appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(UUID checklistKey, S parameter, String value) {
1245    Objects.requireNonNull(checklistKey);
1246
1247    String field = HUMBOLDT_TAXON_COLUMNS.getOrDefault(parameter, null);
1248
1249    if (field == null) {
1250      return;
1251    }
1252
1253    builder
1254        .append('(')
1255        .append(
1256            String.format(
1257                "stringArrayContains(%s['%s']['%s'], %s, true)",
1258                sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(EcoTerm.targetTaxonomicScope),
1259                getChecklistKey(checklistKey),
1260                field,
1261                quote(value)))
1262        .append(')');
1263  }
1264
1265  private void appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(EqualsPredicate<S> taxonPredicate) {
1266    appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(
1267        getChecklistKey(taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1268        taxonPredicate.getKey(),
1269        taxonPredicate.getValue());
1270  }
1271
1272  private void appendHumboldtTaxonFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonPredicate) {
1273    String field = HUMBOLDT_TAXON_COLUMNS.getOrDefault(taxonPredicate.getKey(), null);
1274
1275    if (field == null) {
1276      return;
1277    }
1278
1279    // formatArray quotes and escapes the values
1280    Set<String> taxonKeys = new HashSet<>(taxonPredicate.getValues());
1281
1282    builder
1283        .append('(')
1284        .append(
1285            String.format(
1286                "arrays_overlap(%s[%s]['%s'], array(%s))",
1287                sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(EcoTerm.targetTaxonomicScope),
1288                quote(getChecklistKey(taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()).toString()),
1289                field,
1290                formatArray(taxonKeys)))
1291        .append(')');
1292  }

1294  private void appendHumboldtTaxonUnary(UUID checklistKey, String unaryOperator) {
1295    Objects.requireNonNull(checklistKey);
1296    builder.append('(');
1297    builder.append(
1298        String.format(
1299            "%s['%s']['%s'] " + unaryOperator,
1300            sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(EcoTerm.targetTaxonomicScope),
1301            getChecklistKey(checklistKey),
1302            "usageName"));
1303    builder.append(')');
1304  }

1306  /**
1307   * Searches any of the taxonomic classification keys in Hive of any rank.
1308   *
1309   * @param taxonKeyPredicate to append as filter
1310   */
1311  private void appendTaxonomicArrayFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonKeyPredicate, String sqlField) {
1312    // Using arrays_overlap() instead of EXISTS because it is a standard SQL function
1313    // and may be supported by more SQL engines.
1314    // Also, the expected number of values in the array is small, so performance should be
1315    // acceptable.
1316    builder
1317        .append('(')
1318        .append(
1319            String.format(
1320                "arrays_overlap(%s, array(%s))",
1321                resolveTaxonColumnName(
1322                    sqlField, getChecklistKey(taxonKeyPredicate.getChecklistKey())),
1323                formatArray(taxonKeyPredicate.getValues())))
1324        .append(')');
1325  }

1327  /** Quotes and escapes raw (unquoted) values as a comma-separated list of string literals. */
1328  private String formatArray(Collection<String> values) {
1329    return values.stream().map(SQLQueryVisitor::quote).collect(Collectors.joining(","));
1330  }
1331
1332  /** As {@link #formatArray(Collection)}, wrapping each literal in lower(). */
1333  private String formatArrayLowerCase(Collection<String> values) {
1334    return values.stream().map(v -> toSQLLower(quote(v))).collect(Collectors.joining(","));
1335  }

1337  /**
1338   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank.
1339   *
1340   * @param taxonPredicate to append as filter
1341   */
1342  private void appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonPredicate, String sqlField) {
1343    builder
1344        .append('(')
1345        .append(
1346            String.format(
1347                "%s IN (%s)",
1348                resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1349                formatArray(taxonPredicate.getValues())))
1350        .append(')');
1351  }
1352
1353  /**
1354   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank.
1355   *
1356   * @param taxonPredicate to append as filter
1357   */
1358  private void appendTaxonomicSingleValueFilterCaseInsensitive(
1359      InPredicate<S> taxonPredicate, String sqlField) {
1360    builder
1361        .append('(')
1362        .append(
1363            String.format(
1364                "lower(%s) IN (%s)",
1365                resolveTaxonColumnName(sqlField, taxonPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1366                formatArrayLowerCase(taxonPredicate.getValues())))
1367        .append(')');
1368  }

1370  /** Creates a disjunction of all the given terms. */
1371  private void appendGadmFilterList(List<? extends Term> terms, String value) {
1372    builder
1373        .append('(')
1374        .append(
1375            terms.stream()
1376                .map(
1377                    term ->
1378                        sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term) + EQUALS_OPERATOR + quote(value))
1379                .collect(Collectors.joining(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR)))
1380        .append(')');
1381  }
1382
1383  /**
1384   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank, for multiple keys.
1385   *
1386   * @param taxonomicPredicate to append as filter
1387   */
1388  private void appendTaxonKeyArrayFilter(InPredicate<S> taxonomicPredicate) {
1389
1390    // formatArray quotes and escapes the values
1391    List<String> taxonKeys =
1392        taxonomicPredicate.getValues().stream().distinct().collect(Collectors.toList());
1393
1394    // if the set is huge, use the lambda EXISTS function
1395    // if not, use the arrays_overlap function
1396    // this is to avoid exposing the EXISTS function to some users (cube),
1397    // which is not a standard SQL function and may not be supported by all SQL engines
1398    if (taxonKeys.size() > lambdaQueryThreshold) {
1399      builder
1400          .append('(')
1401          .append(
1402              String.format(
1403                  // using 'taxonkey' as it needs to be a recognised column
1404                  // to get past calcite validation
1405                  "EXISTS(%s, taxonkey -> taxonkey IN (%s))",
1406                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonkeys", taxonomicPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1407                  formatArray(taxonKeys)))
1408          .append(')');
1409    } else {
1410      builder
1411          .append('(')
1412          .append(
1413              String.format(
1414                  "arrays_overlap(%s, array(%s))",
1415                  resolveTaxonColumnName("taxonkeys", taxonomicPredicate.getChecklistKey()),
1416                  formatArray(taxonKeys)))
1417          .append(')');
1418    }
1419  }
1420
1421  /**
1422   * Searches every level of GADM GID in Hive for multiple keys.
1423   *
1424   * @param gadmGids to append as filter
1425   */
1426  private void appendGadmGidFilter(Collection<String> gadmGids) {
1427    builder.append('(');
1428    boolean first = true;
1429    for (Term term : GADM_GIDS) {
1430      if (!first) {
1431        builder.append(DISJUNCTION_OPERATOR);
1432      }
1433      builder.append(sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term)).append(IN_OPERATOR).append('(');
1434      Iterator<String> iterator = gadmGids.iterator();
1435      while (iterator.hasNext()) {
1436        // Hardcoded GADM_LEVEL_0_GID since the type of all these parameters is the same.
1437        // Using .toUpperCase() is safe, GIDs must be ASCII anyway.
1438        builder.append(
1439            toSQLValue(sqlTermsMapper.getDefaultGadmLevel(), iterator.next().toUpperCase(), true));
1440        if (iterator.hasNext()) {
1441          builder.append(", ");
1442        }
1443      }
1444      builder.append(")");
1445      first = false;
1446    }
1447    builder.append(')');
1448  }
1449
1450  /**
1451   * Searches any of the NUB keys in Hive of any rank.
1452   *
1453   * @param unaryOperator to append as filter
1454   */
1455  private void appendUnaryList(List<? extends Term> terms, String unaryOperator) {
1456    builder.append('(');
1457    builder.append(
1458        terms.stream()
1459            .map(term -> sqlColumnsUtils.getSQLQueryColumn(term) + unaryOperator)
1460            .collect(Collectors.joining(CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR)));
1461    builder.append(')');
1462  }

1464  /**
1465   * Converts decimal range into a predicate with the form: field >= range.lower AND field <=
1466   * range.upper.
1467   */
1468  private Predicate toNumberRangePredicate(Range<Double> range, S key) {
1469    if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
1470      return new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1471          key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue()));
1472    }
1473    if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
1474      return new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1475          key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue()));
1476    }
1477
1478    List<Predicate> predicates =
1479        List.of(
1480            new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1481                key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().doubleValue())),
1482            new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1483                key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().doubleValue())));
1484    return new ConjunctionPredicate(predicates);
1485  }
1486
1487  /**
1488   * Converts integer range into a predicate with the form: field >= range.lower AND field <=
1489   * range.upper.
1490   */
1491  private Predicate toIntegerRangePredicate(Range<Integer> range, S key) {
1492    if (!range.hasLowerBound()) {
1493      return new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1494          key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().intValue()));
1495    }
1496    if (!range.hasUpperBound()) {
1497      return new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1498          key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().intValue()));
1499    }
1500
1501    List<Predicate> predicates =
1502        List.of(
1503            new GreaterThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1504                key, String.valueOf(range.lowerEndpoint().intValue())),
1505            new LessThanOrEqualsPredicate<S>(
1506                key, String.valueOf(range.upperEndpoint().intValue())));
1507    return new ConjunctionPredicate(predicates);
1508  }
1509
1510  private void visit(Object object) throws QueryBuildingException {
1511    Method method = null;
1512    try {
1513      method = getClass().getMethod("visit", new Class[] {object.getClass()});
1514    } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
1515      log.warn(
1516          "Visit method could not be found. That means a unknown Predicate has been passed", e);
1517      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown Predicate", e);
1518    }
1519    try {
1520      method.invoke(this, object);
1521    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
1522      log.error(
1523          "This error shouldn't occur if all visit methods are public. Probably a programming error",
1524          e);
1525      throw new RuntimeException(e);
1526    } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
1527      log.info("Exception thrown while building the query", e);
1528      throw new QueryBuildingException(e);
1529    }
1530  }
